independentLineVerification.method: Each case's retained reconstructed lines were re-tested against the governed normalization, transcribed from src/fixtures/eval/metrics.ts.
independentLineVerification.asymmetryNote: Finding the truth confirms truthOnReconstructedLine. Not finding it cannot refute the flag, because the committed line list is capped at 12. Disagreement on a possibly-truncated list is recorded as unverifiable, not as a contradiction.
